steps.body: Play the five chapters in order and finish the final mission. The 12 story trophies pop automatically: the opening mission Gone Fishing, one for each chapter (Chapters 1–4), the gold for the final mission, and six mission trophies — Breakfast Run (Chapter 2), The Cartel Heist (Chapter 3), Child's Play, Headliners and VCIA Takedown (Chapter 4), and Operation Savage Glory (Chapter 5). Do the optional quest strands as they appear — Andy (Lucia only, Chapter 3), Kenton (Chapter 1), Billy (Chapter 2), Randy, Tyrone (Jason only) and Bret (Jason only) — and take the Strangers & Freaks strands when you meet them. Along the way, scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app (200 of 277 needed for 100%), study new animals through binoculars (100 of 255), and keep a save at the start and end of each chapter: there are 15 manual save slots plus 1 autosave, and no mission replay.
steps.title: Step 1 — Finish the story (60–80 hours)
steps.warning: DO THE CHAPTER 1 MEDITATION. One morning at Jason's house, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony. Follow her and accept. It is gone after Chapter 1, and it may be required for Positive Mental Attitude — the only possibly missable trophy.

steps.body: After the story the checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. Progress made during the story already counts. It is lenient — closer to 60% true completion. The lines that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. The rest are partial: any 100 optional missions, any 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, any 100 of 255 animals studied, any 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 15 of 18 meditations and 15 of 18 card sets. Finish the checklist and A Long Road (gold) unlocks.
steps.title: Step 2 — 100% Completion checklist & 70 of 80 challenges (about 100 hours)
steps.warning: Cheats disable trophies and stop the game saving. Keep them off the file you use for this run.

steps.body: Most trophies are done by now. Strangers & Freaks is not part of 100%, so finish the 8 counting strands — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete among them — then clean up whatever is left on the checklist: the last card sets, the last WAiNK scans, the last bank vaults and gang operations. The platinum, Vice Got a Price!, pops when the 54th other trophy does.
steps.title: Step 3 — Strangers & Freaks and cleanup (about 10 hours)

summary: One playthrough, about 200 hours (PowerPyx; Push Square says 250+). No difficulty setting, no mission medals, no mission replay — but free roam continues after the story and nothing on the 100% checklist is missable. The only trophy that can possibly be missed is Positive Mental Attitude, in Chapter 1.
title: Roadmap to the Platinum — Vice Got a Price!
